description: Shared dependency policy for every repository here. They are Rust and Nix
projects, some of them Tauri desktop apps with a Svelte frontend, so one
policy covers cargo, npm, GitHub Actions and the Nix flake.
Renovate replaced Dependabot because Dependabot has no Nix ecosystem,
which left flake.lock as the only part of the toolchain with no
automation behind it. Dependabot's security updates stay enabled in each
repository's settings: they are a separate track this file does not
affect.
Nothing is merged automatically.
minimumReleaseAge is a quarantine: it refuses any release younger than a
week, the window in which a compromised package is normally spotted and
yanked. Where a repository sets pnpm's own minimumReleaseAge, this
complements it: pnpm enforces that one over the whole tree including
transitive packages.
The Nix manager is beta and has to be enabled by hand, and
lockFileMaintenance is what actually refreshes flake.lock; without it
only the inputs written in flake.nix would move.
src-tauri/gen holds the Android project Tauri generates. It is rewritten
from scratch rather than maintained, so a bot updating its Gradle files
proposes changes the next generation discards.

packageRules.description: Majors are never grouped and wait longer: a breaking change must not hold back the rest, and it gets its own pull request to be judged on its own.
flake.lock moves all its inputs at once; splitting them would only produce pull requests that cannot be evaluated apart.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: An advisory that affects us is not quarantined and does not wait for Monday.
